category: EDA Tools and methods for architecture exploration

systemLevelInfo.SWDependencies: SystemC-AMS, Cheshire, RV64 GCC toolchain, Xilinx Vivado, OpenOCD, libjim and Docker
systemLevelInfo.requiresSpecializedTool: Yes. FPGA and SystemC-AMS co-simulation toolchain.

API: Hardware-in-the-loop communication with the Cheshire FPGA platform

deployment.bundle: Open-source Git repository with Docker image, Make targets and FPGA integration files

features.purpose: Observe extra-functional properties while software executes on a real RISC-V FPGA platform.
validatedCapabilities: Reusable make-based setup and test flow
limitations: Default deployment targets ZCU102, although the flow can be adapted to other platforms.
